title: webhooks.payload_envelope
description: Body POSTed for an emitted webhook (BE-WH-9): the JSON object {"webhook_type": <type>, "object_type": <object_type>, "organization_id": <organization id>, <object_type>: <serialized object>} in exactly this key order, encoded per BE-WH-12. Output: `body` (the exact text POSTed) and `webhook_type` (the type recorded for the delivery, equal to the input). Delivery status is not an output of this op (BE-WH-19..22 are graded by webhooks.retry_step).

webhook_type.description: Type recorded for the delivery (the input webhook_type).
